# Add-on for families who already signed the media and publication form (TEMPLATE)

For families who signed the old "vAI lab media and publication consent form". That form covers pictures, voice and
first name for sharing. It does **not** cover your child's use of the learning platform or the sending of their
information to AI companies and computers in the United States. This add-on does. **Draft for a lawyer to check;
translate before use. Replace the [brackets].** One sheet, one side. Keep the signed original; give the parent a copy.

**Using the platform**

**What nextVillage.community is.** A learning website where children learn AI, coding and business skills, with an AI
helper that answers questions, and do projects that help their community.

**What we keep about your child.** Name, school, town, the **year** of birth (not the full date), a photo if the
child adds one, the child's work, chats with the AI helper, scores, and messages in group rooms (for older
children). We do **not** keep ID numbers or a home address.

**Why.** To teach and give feedback, to keep children safe, and to show how the group is doing. Funders
receive grouped numbers, not names. We do not sell information and we show no advertising.

**Who can see it.** The group leader and the nextVillage.community administrators. Other children in the group see a
child's first name and the first letter of the last name (children under 13 appear as "Learner" and a number,
with no photo). The public never sees a child's name on the website; it sees initials only.

**AI helpers and computers in other countries.** What your child types to the AI helper is sent, **after names
and phone numbers are removed**, to AI companies, mostly in the United States. Your child's information is
stored on computers in the **United States** (Ohio). **Risks:** US companies and courts, not Nigerian ones,
control those computers; companies may keep records for a short time; no computer system is perfectly safe.
We choose companies that say they do not use our data to train their AI, we limit what is sent, and we delete
data on a schedule. Children under 13 use only one carefully chosen AI company.

**Safety.** Messages are checked by computer for signs that a child may hurt themselves or others. If so, the
group leader is told and may speak to the child and to you.

**How long.** AI chats are cleared after 90 days (60 days for children under 13). Group messages and files the
child makes are deleted after 12 months (6 months under 13). Accounts not used for a year are reviewed and may be
deleted. We delete everything within 30 days when you ask.

**Your rights.** You can ask to see, correct or delete your child's information, ask for a copy, or **withdraw
this permission at any time**. Tell the group leader **in person**, or contact Confidence Onuoha, our child protection lead, by **WhatsApp/phone** on **+234 806 417 7653** or by **email** at **confidenceonuoha416@gmail.com**.
We reply within 14 days. Withdrawing means your child stops using nextVillage.community and we delete their account.

☐ **I give permission** for my child to use nextVillage.community, and for my child's information to be used and sent
abroad as described above.
